variances.meaning_english: a brave man is called 'ayham', as if no one can find a way to approach him

entries.notes: Reading of 'الأصمّ' for the deaf-man sense confirmed legible on the scan.

entries.core_meaning: كلمةٌ واحدة، وهى يُوحُ: اسمٌ من أسماء الشمس
entries.core_meaning_english: a single word, 'Yuh': one of the names of the sun

entries.core_meaning: كلمةٌ واحدة، هى اليَوْمُ: الواحدُ من الأيّام، ثم يُستعيرونه فى الأمر العظيم
entries.core_meaning_english: a single word, 'day': one of the days, then metaphorically used for a momentous event/battle

variances.meaning: إذا نَزَلَ (أى في وقت الشدة أو النازلة)
variances.meaning_english: said of someone who proves excellent 'on the day' (i.e. in a crisis)
